questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word

Bustle
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Scuttle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bustle"** means to move in an energetic or busy manner, or to display a lot of activity. (हलचल, चहल-पहल)
 
 
• **Example:** The marketplace was bustling with people buying goods and enjoying the festive atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **"Scuttle"** refers to moving quickly with short, hurried steps, often indicating urgency. (दौड़ना/तेजी से भागना)
 
 
• **Example:** The mouse scuttled across the kitchen floor as soon as it heard footsteps.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "scuttle" is the synonym of "bustle" as both words convey an idea of quick, energetic movement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Scuttle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clog** (रुकावट): To block or obstruct something, especially a passage or flow.
 
 
• **Example:** The drain was clogged with leaves after the storm.
 
 
 
• **Cumber** (बाधा डालना): To hinder or obstruct someone or something; to weigh down.
 
 
• **Example:** The heavy backpack cumbered him as he climbed the steep hill.
 
 
 
• **Trammel** (बाधा): To restrict someone's freedom of action or movement.
 
 
• **Example:** The strict rules trammel the creative freedom of the artists.

questions.question:

The person had shown __belligerent__ behaviour towards all his neighbors.
questions.solution:

__
 
• The word **"belligerent"** means hostile, aggressive, or warlike behaviour. (लड़ाकू / आक्रामक)

 
 
• **Example:** The player's belligerent attitude toward the referee led to his expulsion from the game.
 
 
 
• **"Hostile"** refers to being unfriendly, antagonistic, or showing opposition. (शत्रुतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** The hostile crowd booed the speaker throughout his address.
 
 
 
• As "belligerent" and "hostile" both indicate aggression or an unfriendly attitude, they are synonymous.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Hostile)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Indifferent** (उदासीन): Having no particular interest or concern; apathetic.

 
 
• **Example:** He was indifferent to the outcome of the debate.
 
 
 
• **Suspicious** (संदिग्ध): Having or showing a cautious distrust of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was suspicious of his sudden generosity.
 
 
 
• **Hospitable** (अतिथि-सत्कार): Friendly and welcoming to guests or strangers.
 
 
• **Example:** The family was very hospitable and made us feel at home.

questions.question:
**__Direction__: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:**

Nutritionist
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Dietician**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Nutritionist"** refers to a person who is an expert in the field of nutrition and advises people on what to eat to maintain a healthy lifestyle. (पोषण विशेषज्ञ)
 
 
• **Example:** The nutritionist recommended a diet rich in fruits and vegetables to improve my overall health.
 
 
 
• **"Dietician"** is a synonym of nutritionist and refers to a professional trained in nutrition science who provides dietary advice. (आहार विशेषज्ञ)
 
 
• **Example:** The dietician prepared a meal plan tailored to help manage my diabetes.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'Nutritionist'** is **'Dietician'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dietician**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Empathy** (सहानुभूति): The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.
 
 
• **Example:** Her empathy for others makes her a great friend and listener.
 
 
 
• **Entertainer** (मनोरंजनकर्ता): A person who performs to entertain others.
 
 
• **Example:** The entertainer captivated the audience with his magic tricks.
 
 
 
• **Satirist** (विद्रूपकार): A person who uses humor, irony, or ridicule to criticize or expose people's stupidity or vices.
 
 
• **Example:** The satirist wrote a brilliant article mocking the absurdity of the new law.
